method: Exhaustive review of all screen text blocks and visual elements for each step; approximately one-third of interactions sampled per tile. For each concept's steps, checked whether any blocked_future_concept must be understood (not merely mentioned) to follow the content.

defects.description: The table_select interaction task_ci_contains_null uses reject/fail-to-reject language ('the test where we cannot reject H0') and task feedback references 'so we cannot reject H0'. This framing comes from business_conclusion_from_experiment (f2/f3). However, the learner can complete the task using CI knowledge alone (checking whether 0% lift falls inside the interval range), so the reject language functions as supplementary labeling rather than a required understanding. Not blocking because the core tested skill is CI interpretation (significance_confidence_concept#f4), not the reject/fail-to-reject decision framework.
defects.fix: Consider rephrasing task_ci_contains_null prompt to: 'Select the variation row where the 95% confidence interval contains the null value (0% lift) — the test where the data does not provide strong evidence against H0.' and adjusting feedback accordingly. This keeps the language within significance_confidence_concept's scope (evidence against H0 via p-value, f2) without importing the formal reject/fail-to-reject framework from business_conclusion_from_experiment.
